primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The MADRS-10 scale is a clinician-administered questionnaire comprised of 10 items used to measure the severity of MDD symptoms. Scores range from 0 (no apparent symptoms) to 60 (most severe symptoms). Individual questionnaire items include: Apparent Sadness, Reported Sadness, Inner Tension, Reduced Sleep, Reduced Appetite, Concentration Difficulties, Lassitude, Inability to Feel, Pessimistic Thoughts, and Suicidal Thoughts.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The Full Analysis Set (FAS) consists of subjects in the Group 1 Safety Population who have at least 1 post-randomization assessment of MADRS total score.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Change From Baseline to End of Treatment (Week 6) in the Montgomery Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) Total Score
